summary: link-genius export decodes --columns as a JSON array of {key,label} objects and ships a runnable Example with --columns/--total.
reason: The sniffed spec types columns as an array of strings, but Rank Math Pro's Export_Processor reads $column['key'] and $column['label'], so string columns export a blank header and empty rows.
validated_outcome: Live on local Rank Math Pro 3.0.124 with a PRIVATE TEST internal link: job stored columns as objects and the CSV rendered header 'URL,Anchor' plus row 'http://localhost:8889/private-test-post-1,"PRIVATE TEST anchor"'. url/anchor_text are real wp_rank_math_internal_links columns.
notes: tools-manifest.json still types columns as string_csv_array (metadata only; MCP mirrors the Cobra tree). Fix the spec type to array-of-object on regen or this patch is undone.
